Located in Port Melbourne, VIC  
  Day shift, with daily travel allowance  
 
 Programmed are currently seeking a qualified and experienced  Welder/Boilermaker  to join a well-established aviation manufacturer based in Port Melbourne, with occasional work being done in Keilor Park.   
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Perform high-quality  TIG and Oxy welding  on steel components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications, and quality standards. 
 Fabricate, assemble and modify structural steel components, frames, brackets and fabricated assemblies. 
 Read and interpret technical drawings, work instructions and fabrication specifications. 
 Measure, cut, fit and prepare materials using hand and power tools. 
 Grind, finish and inspect completed welds to ensure compliance with quality and safety requirements. 
 Safely operate workshop equipment and maintain tools in good working order. 
 Maintain a clean, organised and safe work environment while adhering to all Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) procedures. 
 Work collaboratively with production, engineering and quality teams to meet manufacturing schedules and project deadlines. 
 Identify fabrication issues and contribute practical solutions to improve quality and efficiency. 
 Maintain a high standard of workmanship while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
 Essential Requirements 
 
  Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade  (Qualified Boilermaker/Welder). 
 Demonstrated experience in  TIG and Oxy welding . 
 Ability to read, interpret and work from engineering drawings and technical specifications. 
 Experience fabricating and assembling steel components to precise tolerances. 
 Strong communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. 
 Proven problem-solving skills with a practical and proactive approach. 
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work. 
 Reliable, punctual and able to commit to a  Monday to Friday  work schedule. 
 Ability to work independently while effectively managing workload and priorities. 
 Physically capable of performing manual fabrication duties in a workshop environment. 
 Commitment to workplace safety and adherence to Boeing's quality and WHS standards. 
 
          Who we are     As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to.    At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.    We welcome and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply.      So it's over to you. If you would like to join our team, APPLY now.       To learn more about working with Programmed, we encourage you to visit our website.     Please  click here  to apply.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Full time opportunity with a monthly ADO!

Based at St Vincent's Hospital Fitzroy Precinct

Friendly and supportive team environment

About the Role
You will be working within the Engineering and Infrastructure Department providing a wide range of administrative support along with other administrative team members.

Answer telephones and emails

Liaise with contractors, create, process work orders and invoices.

Process of utility invoices and tracking of spreadsheet

Classifications for this position will be HS1A ($54,839 per annum pro rata) - HS17 based on previous experience within public health

Your Contribution 

Computer skills and good knowledge of relevant Microsoft applications

Strong communication and problem solving skills

Ability to work independently

Ability to work in a team environment and excellent interpersonal and communication skills

Demonstrate ability to manage multiple tasks in a busy environment

A valid Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check, or willing to obtain

What We Offer

A healthy work-life balance encouraged. Full time employment comes with a monthly Accrued Day Off (additional day off per month!)

Salary Packaging - Increase your take home pay!

In the heart of Fitzroy, CBD at our doorstep, close to Public Transport

Discounts and Promotions always available through our Foundation

Regular opportunities for professional development to assist you to reach your career goals

Culture of continuous improvement

About the Engineering & Infrastructure Team
St Vincent's Engineering & Infrastructure provides corrective and preventative maintenance of all hospital facilities and buildings and manage minor & major projects and asset renewal programs

Engineering also manage main utilities and essential services, ensure compliance with the Building Commission, Building Regulations and Department of Health guidelines.

Working at St Vincent's 
St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne (SVHM) is a leading teaching, research and tertiary health service. SVHM provides a diverse range of adult clinical services and is driven by values of Compassion, Justice, Integrity and Excellence.

Shortlisting for this position will commence immediately. We encourage you to apply promptly as the advertisement may close early should a suitable applicant be sourced.
 

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is essential to our mission and diversity reflects the community we serve.

result.description: Metalwork WA Pty Ltd   Position Overview   Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and motivated Full-time Metal Fabricator to join its fabrication team in Western Australia. The successful applicant will fabricate, assemble, install, maintain, modify, and repair structural steel and other fabricated metal products by interpreting engineering drawings, preparing metal materials, and carrying out welding and fabrication activities while maintaining high standards of quality, precision, and workplace safety.    Key Responsibilities    Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions.  Mark out, measure, cut, shape, and prepare metal sections, plates, pipes, and structural components.  Fabricate, assemble, and install structural steel, frames, platforms, handrails, brackets, truck bodies, and other fabricated metal products.  Fit, align, and join fabricated metal components using appropriate welding processes and fabrication techniques in accordance with engineering specifications.   Operate fabrication equipment including guillotines, press brakes, rollers, drills, saws, grinders, and other workshop machinery.  Inspect fabricated products to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards and engineering specifications.  Repair, modify, and maintain metal structures and fabricated products as required.  Maintain a safe, clean, and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety policies and procedures.  Maintain fabrication equipment and tools in a safe operating condition and comply with workplace health and safety procedures throughout all fabrication activities.     Skills and Experience   The successful applicant should possess:   A qualification relevant to metal fabrication, engineering fabrication, boilermaking, welding, or a closely related trade equivalent to AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).  Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications.  Experience in fabricating, assembling, fitting, installing, modifying, and repairing structural steel and fabricated metal products.   Competency in welding and the safe operation of fabrication machinery and associated hand and power tools.  Strong knowledge of metalworking techniques, measuring equipment, quality control processes, and workplace health and safety requirements.  Good communication skills, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.    What We Offer    Full-time permanent employment with an established Western Australian steel fabrication company.  Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience.  Opportunity to work on diverse commercial, industrial, mining, and infrastructure fabrication projects.  A professional and safety-focused workplace with modern fabrication equipment.  Ongoing opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high-quality fabrication projects.  Supportive team environment with a commitment to quality workmanship and continuous improvement.    Application Process   Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter outlining relevant experience and suitability for the role.  Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.  About Company     METALWORK WA PTY LTD  is a Western Australian steel fabrication company specialising in truck body building, structural steel, and architectural steel fabrication. The company provides end-to-end fabrication services, including design, drafting, manufacturing, blasting, painting, and on-site installation for commercial, industrial, construction, and mining clients. Operating from a fully equipped workshop in Perth, Metalwork WA delivers custom metal fabrication solutions, site welding, and steel construction projects while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, workplace safety, and timely project delivery. The company has been actively operating in Australia since 2009 as a registered Australian proprietary company.
